notes.title: Patch Update
notes.notes:
As some players are aware, Adventure Time: Pirates of the Enchiridion faced a bug at launch. We now have a patch available to download for STEAM, Xbox One and PlayStation 4, with Nintendo Switch to follow soon. 
We apologise to any users who's experience this may have affected playing the game and thank you for your patience! OG Team.

Patch Notes:

Steam Only
Fixed: Correction made to achievement name. Improved: Now using Steam configured language rather than the system language for localisation.

All Platforms
Combat
Fixed: Backing out of using the backpack after selecting a different item than the healing flasks could cause the menu to lock up during the combat tutorial. Fixed: When quitting/closing the game during the combat defeat screen, the health of a player is now restored properly when resuming the game. This now resolves issues when re-engaging in combat. Fixed: Game no longer occasionally hangs after defeating bosses in combat. Fixed: Game no longer randomly hangs when using abilities/attacks/items during combat. Fixed: Defeated Fire Kingdom boss no longer appears in other battle arenas. Fixed: Game no longer occasionally fails to load combat scenes. Fixed: Removed duplicate sky in training / combat scenes in the Evil Forest.
Exploration
Fixed: It is no longer possible to pick up an NPC that another party member is already carrying which then leads to gameplay difficulties Fixed: Marceline’s hat is now placed correctly on the ground when combat starts if a party member is holding it when combat is triggered. Fixed: Occasional bug where users can skip the delivery of Marceline’s hat cutscene is now fixed. If Jake delivers the hat, the cutscene starts when Finn arrives.
Fixed: The game no longer crashes during the “Collect the heat cores” quest when the Marceline only section begins. Fixed: Switching between party members on the steps of the Candy Kingdom Castle will no longer cause them to fall and get stuck. Fixed: Party members no longer sound like they are falling when jumping on treasure chests in the Evil Forest and the Candy Kingdom. Fixed: Morphing into Jake's scooter form has extra checks added to prevent it from being pushed out of the world. Fixed: Pirate ships won't respawn once they've been defeated. Fixed: Kraken music will now always stop playing once the kraken submerges.
Interrogation
Fixed: Reduced random hangs and loading issues that happen in the game after an interrogation has been completed.

Information regarding other platforms' patches is available: goo.gl/67xpu2

notes.title: A Mathmatical Patch is Coming...
notes.notes: We are aware some people have been experiencing bugs with #AdventureTime Pirates of the Enchiridion, so we are hard at work to put a patch out as soon as possible. Please help us squash this by providing information to our support team at support@outrightgames.com

notes.title: Please be aware there is a Day 1 Patch...
notes.notes:
Please note there is a day 1 patch going in at launch across all systems. We recommend you install this patch before starting the game for the best experience, and here are the patch notes.: 
 
New
New functionality for selecting side quests from the map to appear on the HUD
Current dosh amount is now displayed in the pause menu / hero manual 
 
Improved
After completing the Pest Control side quest the area will be cleared of Varmints
Extra health rewards added to Evil Forest before important fight  
BMO lock hacking ability now has new electric visuals and audio
Improved drop off locations for Candy Kids outside the Candy Kingdom for side quest Cool, Calm and Collected. Improved drop off locations for Penguins at Treehouse for the side quest This is Gunter take a while.
The portal leading to the quest Pickled Herring will no longer be active once the quest has been completed
Text stating that you found a page of the Enchiridion will now appear when finding new character abilities
Falling into the cold dark of the belly of the beast will now respawn you to the nearest location you fell from

 
Fixed
Fixed missing ice VFX for Banana Guard ice attacks
Fixed Prismo's dialogue text size
Fixed the Sword of Lighteousness icon to not appearing in the quest-complete graphic
Fixed quest VO to be missing after dying


We hope you all enjoy the game and the patch removes any potential issues from your gameplay, please feel free to message us if you need any help, tips or tricks!


Best,
OG Team!
